title: dev-next: a run that stops keeps its claim, and an owner-merges story stops at its pull request
story: A /dev-next run that stops now keeps the story assigned to its runner, says why, and can be resumed with /dev-next #<N>; only a real question for a person turns it needs-human. A story labelled owner-merges is built, reviewed and brought to green checks, then left open for its owner to try and merge.
no_qa_reason: Skill text the orchestrator follows; nothing a user can drive on main.
